lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੂਪ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahu j a(n)dhe koop kahiaa birad na jaananhee ||
lines.translation: Those mortals whose minds are like deep dark pits do not understand the purpose of life, even when it is explained to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਊਂਧੈ ਕਵਲਿ ਦਿਸਨੑਿ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: man a(n)dhai oo(n)dhai kaval disanhi khare karoop ||
lines.translation: Their minds are blind, and their heart-lotuses are upside-down; they look totally ugly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kahi jaanahi kahiaa bujhahi te nar sughaR saroop ||
lines.translation: Some know how to speak, and understand what they are told. They are wise and beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਦ ਨ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਗੀਅ ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa naad na bed na gee ras ras kas na jaana(n)t ||
lines.translation: Some do not understand about the Sound-current of the Naad or the Vedas, music, virtue or vice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਸਰ ਅਖਰ ਕਾ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਲਹੰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa sudh na budh na akal sar akhar kaa bheu na laha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Some are not blessed with understanding, intelligence, or sublime intellect; they do not grasp the mystery of God's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਅਸਲਿ ਖਰ ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੰਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se nar asal khar j bin gun garab kara(n)t ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are donkeys; they are very proud of themselves, but they have no virtues at all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabh pavit hai dhan sa(n)pai maaiaa ||
lines.translation: To the Gurmukh, everything is sacred: wealth, property, Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਜੋ ਖਰਚਦੇ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har arath jo kharachade de(n)de sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who spend the wealth of the Lord find peace through giving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide tin tot na aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name shall never be deprived.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਟਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa(n) nadaree aavadaa maaiaa sut paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs come to see the Lord, and leave behind the things of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹੋਰੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagataa(n) hor chit na aavaee har naam samaaiaa ||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the devotees do not think of anything else; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan se vadabhaagee ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad jinhaa ek liv laagee ||
lines.translation: They are lovingly attuned to the True Shabad, the Word of the One God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: girah kuta(n)b mahi sahaj samaadhee ||
lines.translation: In their own household and family, they are in natural Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate se sache bairaagee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are truly detached from the world. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganatai sev na hovaee keetaa thaai na paai ||
lines.translation: Calculated service is not service at all, and what is done is not approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio sach na lago bhaau ||
lines.translation: The flavor of the Shabad, the Word of God, is not tasted if the mortal is not in love with the True Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur piaaraa na lagaee manahath aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: The stubborn-minded person does not even like the True Guru; he comes and goes in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਭਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਦਸ ਵਿਖਾਂ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ik vikh agaahaa bhare taa(n) das vikhaa(n) pichhaahaa jaai ||
lines.translation: He takes one step forward, and ten steps back.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: The mortal works to serve the True Guru, if he walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaai satiguroo no milai sahaje rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: He loses his self-conceit, and meets the True Guru; he remains intuitively absorbed in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tinhaa naam na veesarai sache mel milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਇਦੇ ਕੋ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaan malook kahaaide ko rahan na paaee ||
lines.translation: They call themselves emperors and rulers, but none of them will be allowed to stay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੜੑ ਮੰਦਰ ਗਚ ਗੀਰੀਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaRh ma(n)dar gach geereeaa kichh saath na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Their sturdy forts and mansions - none of them will go along with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: soin saakhat paun veg dhrig dhrig chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: Their gold and horses, fast as the wind, are cursed, and cursed are their clever tricks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhateeh a(n)mrit parakaar karahi bahu mail vadhaaee ||
lines.translation: Eating the thirty-six delicacies, they become bloated with pollution.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo devai tisahi na jaananhee manamukh dukh paaee ||23||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh does not know the One who gives, and so he suffers in pain. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋੁਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੇਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRhi paRhi pa(n)dit mounee thake desa(n)tar bhav thake bhekhadhaaree ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and recite until they get tired. They wander through foreign lands in their religious robes, until they are exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai naau kade na paain dukh laagaa at bhaaree ||
lines.translation: In love with duality, they never receive the Name. Held in the grasp of pain, they suffer terribly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhe trai gun sevahi maaiaa kai biuhaaree ||
lines.translation: The blind fools serve the three gunas, the three dispositions; they deal only with Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar kapat udar bharan kai taaee paath paRahi gaavaaree ||
lines.translation: With deception in their hearts, the fools read sacred texts to fill their bellies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve so sukh paae jin haumai vichahu maaree ||
lines.translation: One who serves the True Guru finds peace; he eradicates egotism from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁਨਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paRanaa gunanaa ik naau hai boojhai ko beechaaree ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there is One Name to chant and dwell on; how rare are those who reflect on this and understand. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਂਗੇ ਆਵਣਾ ਨਾਂਗੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa(n)ge aavanaa naa(n)ge jaanaa har hukam paaiaa kiaa keejai ||
lines.translation: Naked we come, and naked we go. This is by the Lord's Command; what else can we do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee vasat soee lai jaaigaa ros kisai siu keejai ||
lines.translation: The object belongs to Him; He shall take it away; with whom should one be angry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s bhaanaa ma(n)ne sahaje har ras peejai ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh accepts God's Will; he intuitively drinks in the Lord's sublime essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sukhadaataa sadaa salaahihu rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Giver of peace forever; with your tongue, savor the Lord. ||2||
